title: `nvs agent init` updates every file it wrote that nobody has edited since, told apart by a fingerprint in the file's own marker
scope:
what a re-run of `nvs agent init` does to the files an earlier run wrote, how a project and an
agent learn that those files are older than the installed binary, and which harnesses get an
adapter. What a pointer may say is [0167](0167.md)'s and unchanged.
